items.title: Rockwell Automation (NYSE:ROK) Exceeds Q2 CY2026 Expectations
items.summary: Industrials automation company Rockwell (NYSE:ROK) reported Q2 CY2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.9% year on year to $2.31 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $9 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.49 per share was 3.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
